sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Emily. In this podcast,
we speak slowly. We use very easy English. We repeat words and sentences. Today, we travel
to Asia. We go to Indonesia. Our city is Yogiacarta. Yogiacarta is cultural. Yogiacarta
is calm. Yogiacarta is very special. Please relax. Please listen slowly.
Let's begin our journey. Part two, Indonesia and Asia. Indonesia is a country in Asia.
It is a very big country. It has many islands. Indonesia has the sea. Indonesia has forests.
Indonesia has mountains. People from many cultures live here. There are many languages.
There are many traditions. Yogiacarta is one important city. It is not the capital of
Indonesia, but it is the heart of culture. Part three, where is Yogiacarta? Yogiacarta is on
island of Java. Java is a very famous island. The city is in the center of Java.
It is not near the sea. It is not very high. The city is easy to reach. Many people visit
every year. It is a popular place in Indonesia. Part four, weather and climate. The weather in
Yogiacarta is warm. It is warm almost every day. There is sun. There is rain. The air feels
tropical. Some days are very hot. Some days are wet. People are used to this weather.
Life continues slowly. People adapt easily. Part five, a city of culture.
Yogiacarta is a cultural city. Culture is very important here. People love art. People love music.
People love dance. Traditional clothes are common. Traditional food is popular. Old traditions are alive.
Have part six, the sultan and the palace. Yogiacarta has a sultan. This is very special.
The sultan lives in a palace. The palace is called kratan. The sultan is respected. People
listen to him. Tradition and modern life live together. Part seven, old streets and daily life.
The streets of Yogiacarta are busy. But life is not fast. People ride motorbikes.
People walk. People sell food on the street. Life feels friendly. People smile a lot.
The city feels warm and human. Part eight, Borobudur temple near Yogiacarta is Borobudur.
Borobudur is very famous. It is a big temple. It is very old. People come from all over the world.
They walk quietly. They feel peace. It is a place of history and spirit. Part nine,
Prambanan temple. Another famous place is Prambanan. It is a Hindu temple.
The towers are tall. The stones are old. At sunset, it is very beautiful. People take photos.
People feel amazed. Pampart 10, food in Yogiacarta. Food in Yogiacarta is sweet and soft.
People like rice, people like vegetables. A famous dish is good egg. It is made from jack fruit.
It is sweet. Food is cheap. Food is everywhere. Eating is part of daily life.
Students and modern life. Yogiacarta is a student city. Many students live here.
There are universities. There are libraries. There are cafes. Young people study and relax.
Old people keep traditions. The city has balance.
Part 12, nature, spirit and goodbye. Nature is close to Yogiacarta. There are mountains.
There are rivers. Mount Marapi is nearby. It is an active volcano. People respect it.
Yogiacarta is a city of culture, history, students and spirit.
